# gtk4 lays a box out as CSS's flex does, in both languages: C records the
# snapshots, and Go is held to them. Each colored box is where it should be,
# measured off the snapshot when it was recorded:
#
# - justifyContent places two 40px children in a 300px row with a 10px gap:
#   start at 0 and 50, center 105 and 155, end 210 and 260, spaceBetween 0
#   and 260, spaceAround 52 and 207, spaceEvenly 70 and 190, where a GtkBox
#   packs them from the start;
# - flex 1 and 3 share a 410px row's 400 free pixels as 100 and 300, and a
#   410px column's the same way down, where a GtkBox splits them evenly;
# - a box holding a growing child is its content's size beside a growing
#   sibling, which takes the row, where GTK carries the child's expand up to
#   the box;
# - a component's growing root grows in the column its instance is in, as
#   CSS's display: contents places it.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c flex.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go flex.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A scroll holding more than it shows draws its pictures at their height.
# Its viewport laid the content out at its minimum height, which for a
# picture is nothing, so a scroll whose text alone overflowed it drew no
# picture at all.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c pictures.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go pictures.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- flex.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// Each color is one box, so a snapshot shows where each landed.
component tile(shade color) ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={width=40px, height=10px, background=shade}) {}
}

component justified(how ui.Justification) ui.node {
    ui.hbox(style={width=300px, height=10px, gap=10px, justifyContent=how}) {
        tile(shade=#FF0000)
        tile(shade=#0000FF)
    }
}

component grower(shade color) ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={flex=1.0, width=50px, background=shade}) {}
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={gap=4px}) {
        justified(how=ui.Justification.start)
        justified(how=ui.Justification.center)
        justified(how=ui.Justification.end)
        justified(how=ui.Justification.spaceBetween)
        justified(how=ui.Justification.spaceAround)
        justified(how=ui.Justification.spaceEvenly)
        ui.hbox(style={width=410px, height=10px, gap=10px}) {
            ui.vbox(style={flex=1.0, background=#00AA00}) {}
            ui.vbox(style={flex=3.0, background=#AA00AA}) {}
        }
        ui.hbox(style={width=300px, height=10px}) {
            ui.hbox {
                ui.vbox(style={flex=1.0, background=#FF8800}) {}
            }
            ui.vbox(style={flex=1.0, background=#008888}) {}
        }
        ui.hbox(style={gap=10px}) {
            ui.vbox(style={width=50px, height=410px, gap=10px}) {
                ui.vbox(style={flex=1.0, background=#884400}) {}
                ui.vbox(style={flex=3.0, background=#448800}) {}
            }
            ui.vbox(style={width=50px, height=300px}) {
                ui.vbox(style={height=20px, background=#000088}) {}
                grower(shade=#880000)
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testFlex(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("flex")
}
-- pictures.sngl --
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import seq "sngl:seq"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// A scroll holding more than it shows still shows its pictures, drawn at
// their height rather than the nothing a picture's minimum is.
component pictures ui.node {
    ui.scroll(style={height=300px}) {
        ui.vbox {
            for var i = seq.count(10) {
                ui.image {
                    draw.image(width=200.0, height=200.0) {
                        draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=200.0, style={fill=#FF0000})
                    }
                }
                ui.text(value="line\nline\nline\nline\nline\nline\nline\nline\nline\nline {i}")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testPictures(t test.Test, c pictures) {
    t.snapshot("pictures")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    pictures()
}
